title: Connect your sources
body: Authorize GitHub, Linear, or Jira in two clicks. Signal starts listening to merges, closed issues, and shipped tickets immediately.

title: Review the draft
body: Each release arrives pre-written in plain customer language. Edit anything, drop what's internal, and match your voice once — Signal remembers.

title: Publish everywhere
body: One click sends it to your hosted changelog, the in-app widget, email, Slack, and RSS. Every channel, one source of truth.
